test_parallel_user_creation: test creating multiple users in parallel by calling new_user concurrently with asyncio gather
test_user_info_access_control: test user info retrieval as admin, as the user themselves, and as a random unauthorized user
test_user_model_access: test that users can only access models they have permission for and get errors on unauthorized models
test_key_update_user_isolation: test that a user cannot update a key to belong to another user and receives a 403 error
test_key_delete_user_isolation: test that a user cannot delete another user key and receives a 403 error
